query: SELECT ResourceAttributes['host.name'] AS host,count() AS count,min(Timestamp) AS first_seen,max(Timestamp) AS last_seen,substring(argMax(Body,Timestamp),1,2000) AS latest_body FROM external.otel_logs WHERE ResourceAttributes['network']='glamsterdam-msf-2' AND ResourceAttributes['container.name']='beacon' AND Timestamp>=toDateTime('2026-10-14 11:48:30') AND Timestamp<toDateTime('2026-10-14 13:48:30') AND match(Body,'Timeout while getting execution payload|no local.*payload|No local.*payload') GROUP BY host ORDER BY host LIMIT 50 SETTINGS max_threads=2
